panels.description: Adrian's blue projection appears above the workbench. Alex and Bi11bot face it. Leave upper projection space.
Adrian's projected face admits failure; keep the image restrained and leave upper space.
Alex grips Adrian's watch while the recording continues. Leave upper workshop space.
The projection flickers beside the empty workshop doorway. Leave upper space for the final line.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Alex. If you’re seeing this, I failed to come back.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I borrowed too much. I gambled some of it. I hurt you and Grandmother.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: The work was shared. The mistakes were mine.
